job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2023 Illinois Teachers’ Retirement System RFP for general investment consulting services, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES Issued January 13, 2023 Responses due February 9, 2023, by 2:00 pm CST
The Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois (the System or TRS) is requesting proposals to provide general investment consulting services
